snippet.title: Draw, Draw, Pass! - Official Women-Led Update Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Women-Led Update Trailer for Draw, Draw, Pass! a multiplayer drawing game developed by Lucky Roll Studio. Players can gain access to new content with the latest update, alongside a look at the studio's next game with The Witches Whisk. Draw, Draw, Pass! is available now for PC (Steam).
